cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)
project(sakura_storage_tests LANGUAGES CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_CL_SHOWINCLUDES_PREFIX "メモ: インクルード ファイル:  ")
set(CMAKE_CL_SHOWINCLUDES_PREFIX "${CMAKE_CXX_CL_SHOWINCLUDES_PREFIX}")

# Generated by tools/build/sakura_build.py. Do not edit.
get_filename_component(SAKURA_REPO_ROOT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../../../../../../.." ABSOLUTE)
include("${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../../mingw-x64-debug.cmake")
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)
set(CMAKE_OBJECT_PATH_MAX 220)

add_library(sakura_security STATIC
  "${SAKURA_REPO_ROOT}/sakura_core/platform/security/CurrentUserSecurityAttributes.cpp"
  "${SAKURA_REPO_ROOT}/sakura_core/include/sakura/security/CurrentUserSecurityAttributes.h"
)
target_include_directories(sakura_security PUBLIC "${SAKURA_REPO_ROOT}/sakura_core/include")
target_compile_features(sakura_security PRIVATE cxx_std_20)
target_compile_options(sakura_security PRIVATE -fpack-struct=8 -include "${SAKURA_REPO_ROOT}/src/main/modules/generated/abi/mingw-x64-debug/sakura_security.h")
target_compile_definitions(sakura_security PRIVATE _WIN32_WINNT=0x0A00 NOMINMAX UNICODE _UNICODE)
target_link_libraries(sakura_security PUBLIC advapi32)

add_library(sakura_storage STATIC
  "${SAKURA_REPO_ROOT}/sakura_core/platform/storage/CAtomicFileStorageService.cpp"
  "${SAKURA_REPO_ROOT}/sakura_core/platform/storage/StorageSnapshotCache.cpp"
  "${SAKURA_REPO_ROOT}/sakura_core/platform/storage/StorageTypes.cpp"
  "${SAKURA_REPO_ROOT}/sakura_core/include/sakura/storage/IStorageAuthority.h"
  "${SAKURA_REPO_ROOT}/sakura_core/include/sakura/storage/IStorageService.h"
  "${SAKURA_REPO_ROOT}/sakura_core/include/sakura/storage/StorageAuthorityFactory.h"
  "${SAKURA_REPO_ROOT}/sakura_core/include/sakura/storage/StorageSnapshotCache.h"
  "${SAKURA_REPO_ROOT}/sakura_core/include/sakura/storage/StorageTypes.h"
  "${SAKURA_REPO_ROOT}/sakura_core/platform/storage/CAtomicFileStorageService.h"
)
target_include_directories(sakura_storage PUBLIC "${SAKURA_REPO_ROOT}/sakura_core/include")
target_include_directories(sakura_storage PRIVATE "${SAKURA_REPO_ROOT}/sakura_core/platform/storage")
target_compile_features(sakura_storage PRIVATE cxx_std_20)
target_compile_options(sakura_storage PRIVATE -fpack-struct=8 -include "${SAKURA_REPO_ROOT}/src/main/modules/generated/abi/mingw-x64-debug/sakura_storage.h")
target_compile_definitions(sakura_storage PRIVATE _WIN32_WINNT=0x0A00 NOMINMAX UNICODE _UNICODE)
target_link_libraries(sakura_storage PRIVATE sakura_security)
target_link_libraries(sakura_storage PUBLIC bcrypt)

add_executable(sakura_storage_tests
  "${SAKURA_REPO_ROOT}/tools/build/pilots/storage_contract_test.cpp"
)
target_include_directories(sakura_storage_tests PRIVATE "${SAKURA_REPO_ROOT}/sakura_core/include")
target_compile_features(sakura_storage_tests PRIVATE cxx_std_20)
target_compile_options(sakura_storage_tests PRIVATE -fpack-struct=8 -include "${SAKURA_REPO_ROOT}/src/main/modules/generated/abi/mingw-x64-debug/sakura_storage_tests.h")
target_compile_definitions(sakura_storage_tests PRIVATE _WIN32_WINNT=0x0A00 NOMINMAX UNICODE _UNICODE)
target_link_libraries(sakura_storage_tests PRIVATE sakura_storage)
target_link_libraries(sakura_storage_tests PRIVATE sakura_security)
target_link_options(sakura_storage_tests PRIVATE /INCREMENTAL:NO "/MAP:${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/sakura_storage_tests.map")

enable_testing()
add_test(NAME sakura_storage_tests COMMAND sakura_storage_tests)
